{{recipesummary|category=Vegan recipes| Yield = 1 bowl|time=10 minutes|difficulty=1}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Vegan cuisine|Vegan Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Breakfast Recipes|Breakfast]]

This spread consists of three base ingredients: mashed beans, oat flakes and raw spelt flour. It can be used as spread or can be fried as [[Cookbook:Spelt Burger|burgers]].

==Ingredients==
*250 [[Cookbook:g|g]] mashed [[cookbook:beans|beans]] (white beans or [[cookbook:Kidney Bean|kidney beans]]) 
*150 g [[cookbook:Oats|oat flakes]]
*150 g raw [[cookbook:Spelt|spelt flour]]
*[[cookbook:Vegetable Oil|vegetable oil]]
*Optional:
**[[cookbook:salt|Salt]]
**[[cookbook:garlic|Garlic]]
**[[cookbook:pepper|Pepper]]
**[[cookbook:Herbs and Spices|Herbs and spices]]
**Seasoning mix ([[cookbook:Corn Flour|corn flour]], [[cookbook:salt|salt]], [[cookbook:Chili Pepper|chili]], [[cookbook:onion|onion]], [[cookbook:garlic|garlic]], [[cookbook:paprika|paprika]], [[cookbook:MSG|sodium glutamate]]) (e.g., Mexican Taco Seasoning Mix)

==Procedure==
# Take oat flakes, raw spelt, beans and some water and oil for the base substance.
# Mash the beans and mix the ingredients. 
# Add the optional ingredients to taste.
